workflow_nonnegotiables: Build all screens in HTML and CSS first.
Use AI image generation only for artwork and decorative assets.
Verify screens in browser screenshots before Figma.
Capture into a fresh, organized Figma file.
Do not hand-build placeholder vector UI in Figma when a working HTML version already exists.
This is not a pilot; complete the full spec unless the user explicitly requests a subset.
Restate coverage before building and use it as the execution checklist.
Do not use art-assignment lists as the screen inventory.
If any required screen or page is missing, report the result as PARTIAL.
failure_conditions: Onboarding has fewer than 13 required screens plus the optional review handoff.
Premium has fewer than 6 total screens in the standalone premium page.
Onboarding screen 11 is not a connected infographic timeline with a visible line and milestone cards.
Premium screen 2 is not a connected infographic timeline with a visible line and milestone icons.
Onboarding screen 12 is not a trust/testimonials screen.
Premium price appears before screen 4 offer sheet.
Any required Figma page is missing.
Any required reusable system is missing.
required_reusable_systems: day/date carousel for schedule-related compact screens
proof review queue and proof detail workflow

art_requirements.system_rule: Create a reusable art system first: 4 to 6 hero illustrations, 12 to 20 transparent reusable mini-illustrations or icons, then reuse them across onboarding, empty states, celebrations, premium, and coordination scenes.

rules: 10 to 12 connected onboarding screens at full fidelity, plus optional review handoff.
Use overlapping phone frames and visible connector arrows in the overall lane.
Reuse the user name 3 or more times after capture.
At least one trust-building screen must appear before premium handoff.
On compact screens, response-based onboarding screens must use single-column full-width rows only.
